title: Intro to TypeScript
line: Types, interfaces, unions and generics. Catch bugs before you run.

project.title: A library loan tracker
project.brief: Write loans.ts on your own. An interface for a book, a union type for its status, functions to lend and return, and a generic find by id. Compile it with strict on.
checks: npx tsc finishes with no errors with strict on
No value in loans.ts is typed any
The compiled script prints which books are out and which are in

lessons.title: Compile your first TypeScript file
lessons.goal: Teach a JavaScript learner to install TypeScript with npm, write greet.ts in VS Code with a typed name, compile it with npx tsc greet.ts and run greet.js with node.
lessons.passes: greet.js sits next to greet.ts and prints the greeting.

lessons.title: Set up tsconfig with strict on
lessons.goal: Teach tsconfig.json by building a starter project. Run npx tsc --init, set rootDir to src, outDir to dist and strict to true, then compile src/index.ts with npx tsc.
lessons.passes: tsconfig.json has strict set to true and npx tsc writes dist/index.js.

lessons.title: Type annotations
lessons.goal: Teach TypeScript type annotations for string, number and boolean by typing every variable in a taxi fare calculator in taxi.ts.
lessons.passes: taxi.ts compiles with no errors and prints the fare for 8 km at night.

lessons.title: Read and fix type errors
lessons.goal: Teach reading TypeScript compiler errors by fixing a broken invoice script, one error at a time, until npx tsc reports none and no value is typed any.
lessons.passes: invoice.ts compiles with no errors and prints the invoice total.

lessons.title: Typed functions
lessons.goal: Teach typed functions in TypeScript, with parameter types, return types and optional and default parameters, by writing a sales tax function called three ways.
lessons.passes: The function has typed parameters and a number return type and prints three totals.

lessons.title: Arrays and tuples
lessons.goal: Teach TypeScript typed arrays and tuples by building a medal table as pairs of a country and a gold count and printing the country in the lead.
lessons.passes: The table is an array of string and number tuples and the leader prints.

lessons.title: Interfaces
lessons.goal: Teach TypeScript interfaces with optional properties by describing a pet in a shelter roster and writing a function that lists the pets not yet adopted.
lessons.passes: A Pet interface types the roster and only pets not adopted print.

lessons.title: Union types and narrowing
lessons.goal: Teach TypeScript union types, literal types and narrowing with a switch by writing an area calculator for circles, squares and rectangles.
lessons.passes: One function takes a union of three shapes and prints the right area for each.

lessons.title: Generics
lessons.goal: Teach TypeScript generics by writing first, last and unique helpers that keep the element type, then using them on numbers and on strings.
lessons.passes: Each helper has a type parameter and works on both arrays with no any.
